title: Tighter US chip rules set to favor Qualcomm and MediaTek
html:
The US Department of Commerce has introduced stricter chip technology controls affecting China and several Southeast Asian and Latin American countries, requiring case-by-case approval for shipments of products built on processes below 16/14nm...
